title: ‘SPY×FAMILY’ Vol. 18 Tops Billboard Japan Book Hot 100 as Latest ‘Dandadan’ & ‘SAKAMOTO DAYS’ Volumes Follow
summary: Last week’s No. 1, Yuu Nagira’s Nanji, Hoshi no Gotoku, slips to No. 4.
contentText:
Tatsuya Endo’s SPY×FAMILY Vol. 18 hits No. 1 on the Billboard Japan Book Hot 100 chart released Nov. 12.

Released Nov. 4, the volume claims the top spot by leading three metrics: brick-and-mortar, e-commerce (EC) and e-books. The previous volume of the same title also reached No. 1 on the chart released Apr. 9 (tracking the week from Mar. 30 to Apr. 5), sweeping brick-and-mortar and e-books, and the new volume now makes it two consecutive No. 1s for the series, this time with a three-metric sweep. The series has surpassed 42 million copies in circulation through Vol. 18, and on Nov. 8, during the tracking week, it was announced that the TV anime’s Season 4 will air and a second theatrical film will open, both in 2027.

The latest volumes of two more Jump Comics series, also released Nov. 4, follow: Yukinobu Tatsu’s Dandadan Vol. 26 at No. 2 and Yuto Suzuki’s SAKAMOTO DAYS Vol. 29 at No. 3. Dandadan Vol. 26 places No. 2 in brick-and-mortar, No. 2 in e-books and No. 9 in EC, while SAKAMOTO DAYS Vol. 29 comes in at No. 3 in brick-and-mortar, No. 4 in e-books and No. 12 in EC. Takahiro and Yohei Takemura’s Mato Seihei no Slave Vol. 22 debuts at No. 5, placing No. 3 in e-books. Six of this week’s top 10 titles are new entries.

Last week’s No. 1, Yuu Nagira’s Nanji, Hoshi no Gotoku , slips to No. 4. Now in its 52nd week on the chart, the novel continues to draw steady support, placing No. 1 in subscriptions, No. 1 in social media and No. 4 in brick-and-mortar. Last week’s No. 2, Akiko Abe’s Cafuné , comes in at No. 6, placing No. 2 in social media, No. 6 in brick-and-mortar and No. 8 in subscriptions. Nagira’s Hoshi wo Amu also lands at No. 8, placing No. 6 in social media and No. 17 in brick-and-mortar, as long-selling novel titles stay near the top.

Further down the top 10, Katsuhisa Minami’s The Fable: The Third Secret Vol. 6 debuts at No. 7, placing No. 13 in brick-and-mortar and No. 15 in e-books. Shinichi Ishizuka and NUMBER8’s BLUE GIANT MOMENTUM Vol. 9 drops 4-9, placing No. 5 in brick-and-mortar and No. 17 in EC. Ken Kawasaki and Yu Furusawa’s Oi! Tonbo Vol. 65 enters at No. 10, placing No. 5 in e-books.

The Billboard Japan Book Hot 100 is a comprehensive chart combining physical books, e-books, subscriptions such as library loans, and social media buzz. Below are the top 10 titles on this week’s list, tracking the week from Nov. 2 to 8.

(Numbers in parentheses indicate the title’s metric placements for brick-and-mortar, EC, e-books, subscriptions, and social media, top 20 only. English title given if translations or adaptations exist.)
